inputs.description: Password of the admin user. It is applied at each start, so change the Secret to rotate it. Generated at installation.
inputs.name: adminPassword

zh-CN.summary: 推送通知服务器，主题需要账号，消息存在卷上。

zh-TW.summary: 推播通知伺服器，主題需要帳號，訊息存在磁碟區。

metadata.name: ntfy
metadata.summary: A push notification server where topics need an account and messages stay on a volume.

zh-CN.summary: 以 UID 1000 运行，文件系统只读，没有 Kubernetes 令牌，也去掉了所有额外的系统权限。对外连接没有限制。匿名用户不能读写主题。

zh-TW.summary: 以 UID 1000 執行，檔案系統唯讀，沒有 Kubernetes 權杖，也拿掉了所有額外的系統權限。對外連線沒有限制。匿名使用者不能讀寫主題。

zh-CN.mitigation: 这个模板把 auth-default-access 设成 deny-all。admin 用户可以读写所有主题。要创建用户、访问规则和令牌，请在 Pod 里运行 ntfy user、ntfy access 和 ntfy token。
zh-CN.risk: ntfy 默认让任何人都能发布和读取任何主题。

zh-TW.mitigation: 這個範本把 auth-default-access 設成 deny-all。admin 使用者可以讀寫所有主題。要建立使用者、存取規則和權杖，請在 Pod 裡執行 ntfy user、ntfy access 和 ntfy token。
zh-TW.risk: ntfy 預設讓任何人都能發佈和讀取任何主題。

risks.mitigation: This template sets auth-default-access to deny-all. The admin user can read and write all topics. To create users, access rules and tokens, run ntfy user, ntfy access and ntfy token in the Pod.
risks.risk: By default, ntfy lets anyone publish to and read any topic.

zh-CN.mitigation: Android 和网页客户端会用自己的连接收消息。想用 upstream-base-url 或其他发送方式，请到 ntfy 设置里自己加。
zh-CN.risk: iOS app 的即时推送、Firebase、网页推送、电子邮件和电话通知都是关闭的。

zh-TW.mitigation: Android 和網頁用戶端會用自己的連線收訊息。想用 upstream-base-url 或其他寄送方式，請到 ntfy 設定裡自己加。
zh-TW.risk: iOS app 的即時推送、Firebase、網頁推播、電子郵件和電話通知都是關閉的。

risks.mitigation: Android and web clients receive messages over their own connection. To use upstream-base-url or another sender, set it in the ntfy configuration.
risks.risk: Instant delivery to the iOS app, Firebase, web push, email and calls are off.

zh-CN.mitigation: 附件缓存总共最多 2G，单个文件最多 15M。消息缓存只保留 12 小时的消息。
zh-CN.risk: 附件会占用存储卷的磁盘空间。

zh-TW.mitigation: 附件快取總共最多 2G，單一檔案最多 15M。訊息快取只保留 12 小時的訊息。
zh-TW.risk: 附件會佔用儲存空間的磁碟。

risks.mitigation: The attachment cache is limited to 2G in total and 15M per file. The message cache keeps 12 hours of messages.
risks.risk: Attachments use disk space on the volume.

security.summary: The container runs as UID 1000 with a read-only filesystem, no Kubernetes token and all extra system privileges removed. Outbound traffic is not limited. Anonymous users cannot read or write topics.

manifests:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: ntfy-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: ntfy
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  serviceName: ntfy
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: ntfy
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: ntfy
        app.kubernetes.io/name: ntfy
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: ntfy
        image: binwiederhier/ntfy:v2.38.1@sha256:038da2be5e668fee6d36a62884eea48975e1b71c29a56964e5298c1b9165a573
        # auth-users takes a bcrypt hash. Hash the generated password at each
        # start, so the Secret stays the source of the admin password.
        command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -ec
        - |
          hash="$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$ADMIN_PASSWORD" "$ADMIN_PASSWORD" | ntfy user hash | sed -n 's/.*\(\$2[aby]\$.*\)/\1/p')"
          [ -n "$hash" ]
          unset ADMIN_PASSWORD
          export NTFY_AUTH_USERS="admin:$hash:admin"
          exec ntfy serve
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop: [ALL]
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: '1'
            memory: 512Mi
        env:
        - name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: ntfy-secrets
              key: admin-password
        - name: NTFY_BASE_URL
          value: https://{{ .Domain }}
        - name: NTFY_LISTEN_HTTP
          value: :8080
        - name: NTFY_BEHIND_PROXY
          value: 'true'
        - name: NTFY_CACHE_FILE
          value: /var/lib/ntfy/cache.db
        - name: NTFY_AUTH_FILE
          value: /var/lib/ntfy/user.db
        - name: NTFY_AUTH_DEFAULT_ACCESS
          value: deny-all
        - name: NTFY_ENABLE_LOGIN
          value: 'true'
        - name: NTFY_ATTACHMENT_CACHE_DIR
          value: /var/lib/ntfy/attachments
        - name: NTFY_ATTACHMENT_TOTAL_SIZE_LIMIT
          value: 2G
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /var/lib/ntfy
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /v1/health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 60
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /v1/health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 10
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /v1/health
            port: http
          periodSeconds: 20
          failureThreshold: 6
      volumes:
      - name: data
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: ntfy-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 256Mi
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: ntfy
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: ntfy
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: ntfy
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts: ['{{ .Domain }}']
    secretName: ntfy-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: ntfy
            port:
              number: 8080
